title: Encode and Decode Strings
description:
Design an algorithm to **encode a list of strings into a single string**, and a matching algorithm to **decode that string back into the original list**.

Implement both functions. The test calls `decode(encode(strs))` and expects the original list back. The strings may contain **any characters**, including digits, `#`, commas, quotes and spaces, and may be empty. Your encoded form must be a string, and it must not depend on any state shared between the two calls.
constraints: strs[i] may contain any ASCII character.
hints: A separator character is not safe, because the strings might contain it.
Prefix every string with its length and a delimiter (for example `4#abcd`). When decoding, read the length first, then take exactly that many characters.
